_key.description: Unique identifier for the genomic element to gene edge: CRISPR_{chr}_{start}_{end}_GRCh38_{readout_gene}_{file_accession}

_to.description: Readout gene whose expression was measured for this element-gene association

source_url.description: IGVF portal URL for the source tabular file

files_filesets.description: Associated files_filesets record for the source IGVF tabular file

enum: regulatory element effect on gene expression

method.description: Assay method from the associated files_filesets record

crispr_modality.description: CRISPR perturbation modality from the associated files_filesets record (interference, activation, or knockout)

biosample_term.description: Ontology term for the biosample / cell type used in the screen

biological_context.description: Short sample summary for the biosample (e.g. cell line name)

treatments_term_ids.description: Treatment ontology term IDs applied to the biosample, when present on the files_filesets record

p_value.description: Uncorrected p-value for the element-gene association from the source analysis..

p_value_adj.description: Multiple-testing-adjusted p-value for the element-gene association (Bonferroni, Benjamini-Hochberg FDR, or assay-specific correction as reported by the source).

neg_log10_pvalue.description: Negative log10 of p_value. Capped when p_value is zero.

neg_log10_pvalue_adj.description: Negative log10 of p_value_adj. Capped when p_value_adj is zero.

log2FC.description: Primary signed effect on readout-gene expression for the element perturbation. Typically log2 fold change (positive = increased expression in the perturbed group; negative = decreased).

log2FC_ci95_lower.description: Lower bound of a 95% confidence interval for log2FC.

log2FC_ci95_upper.description: Upper bound of a 95% confidence interval for log2FC.

pct_1.description: Percentage of cells in the first comparison group (typically the perturbed group) where the readout gene is detected.

pct_2.description: Percentage of cells in the second comparison group (typically the reference / control group) where the readout gene is detected.

significant.description: Whether the element-gene association is called significant. Derived by the adapter: p_value_adj (else p_value) < 0.05 when a p-value is available; otherwise |z_score| >= ~1.96 (two-tailed alpha = 0.05).

effect_size.description: Native perturbation effect on readout expression when reported separately from log2FC.

effect_size_ci_95.description: Half-width of the 95% confidence interval on effect_size.

num_guides.description: Number of guides (gRNAs / sgRNAs) targeting the perturbed element.

fold_change.description: Linear fold change of readout expression in perturbed versus background or control cells. Values greater than 1 indicate up-regulation; values less than 1 indicate down-regulation.

background_corrected_fold_change.description: Fold change of readout expression in perturbed cells versus a matched or selected background.

gamma_approximation_ln_p_value.description: Natural log of the pySpade Significance_score (gamma-approximation significance after background correction).

hypergeometric_ln_p_value.description: Natural log of the pySpade hypergeometric p-value (log(pval)-hypergeom): initial test of perturbed versus all other cells without random-background correction.

empirical_p_value.description: pySpade pval-empirical: empirical p-value comparing the perturbation hypergeometric p-value to random background draws.

cpm_perturb.description: Counts per million reads for the readout gene in cells carrying perturbation guides at the element.

cpm_bg.description: Counts per million reads for the readout gene in background (non-perturbed) cells.

num_cells.description: Number of cells with perturbation guides targeting the element. When multiple sgRNAs target the same region, cells are pooled.

z_score.description: Phenotype or enrichment z-score for the element-gene association when reported by the source.

t_score.description: T-statistic for the element-gene association when reported by the source.

idr.description: Irreproducible discovery rate summarizing cross-replicate reproducibility of guide-level signals for the element-gene association. Lower values indicate higher reproducibility.

accessible_via.return: class, label, method, crispr_modality, source, source_url, files_filesets, biological_context, biosample_term
